_: Copy to config.json (ignored by git) and fill in. Every program reads it; nothing in it is ever printed.

inverter._: Shown on the settings page's passport; serial, firmware and pn are optional.
inverter.model: Volt Polska SINUS PRO ULTRA 3000 12/230 V

cloud._: Only for the DessMonitor cloud poller (scripts/). The company key is the one the DessMonitor web app sends; pn/sn/devcode/devaddr are your device's, from the web app.

telegram._: Only for notifications. botEnv: a file holding BOT_TOKEN=...; chatId: your own chat with that bot.
